entities.summary: Cyril Julian is a French former men's professional basketball player. He spent most of his club career with the pro club SLUC Nancy in France. Julian was a 3 time French League French Player's MVP. Julian also played with the senior men's French national basketball team. He won a silver medal at the 2000 Summer Olympics, while playing with France's national team. He was inducted into the French Basketball Hall of Fame in 2021.
